worked_solution:
Using a cofactor expansion along the $3$rd column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ -1 & 5 & \sqrt{5} & 1\end{aligned}| & =\sqrt{3}\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{23}+0\cdot {C}_{33}+\sqrt{5}\cdot {C}_{43} \\  & =\sqrt{3}\cdot (-1)^{1+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}|+\sqrt{5}\cdot (-1)^{4+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =\sqrt{3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & -1 \\ -1 & 5 & 1\end{aligned}|-\sqrt{5}\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & -1 & 1 \\ -2 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
